exceptions.reason: Expo 57 currently resolves image-size through Metro. The affected parser is build tooling and is not shipped as application runtime code.
mitigations: Metro processes only reviewed, version-controlled application assets in the release workflow.
Untrusted customer uploads are scanned by the separate server-side malware workflow and are never passed to Metro.
The exception is exact, time-limited and must be removed when Expo publishes a non-breaking patched dependency tree.
